## Share water data

If you hold water-quality observations from a region of oil and gas development, start with our [contribution guidance](database/contribute-data.qmd). A description of the area, measurements, sampling period, and sharing permissions will help the team understand the dataset.

## Use data in research or teaching

Browse [published datasets and studies](database/data-highlights.qmd) or [teaching resources](education/index.qmd). Contact the team if you need help identifying a suitable dataset or want to discuss a research or classroom use.

## Help organize records

If you are interested in contributing time to data organization, tell us about your experience with water data, laboratory reports, spreadsheets, or scientific documentation. The team can discuss whether there is a suitable task.

## Contact

[Email Tao Wen](mailto:twen08@syr.edu) or [open the interest form](https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=AqR4Qp4auU6EFP-1Wl_PHqeugXhq_MJAqTX6weqo38lUNEhKVTI0SlRLNUQ0RjIzOEg1VVYwOTgwTy4u).

Please use the form for an initial description. Do not include confidential reports, personal information, or protected site locations; discuss an appropriate transfer route with the team first.
